{{Vanilla|Arrow}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''arrow''' is ammunition for bows and crossbows. [[Matcha Flavoured]] doubles its recipe output and sells it cheaply.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Flint, a stick and a feather make 8 arrows, where vanilla makes 4; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/arrow.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Fletcher]] sells 64 arrows for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/1/arrow.json}}</ref>
